name: ci-waste-control-plane
description: Self-hosted control plane for CI waste: backfills the last 100 GitHub Actions runs per repo, computes per-workflow/per-repo cost, categorizes waste (superseded runs, push+PR duplicates, zombie crons, flaky jobs, missing timeouts), shows a dashboard of top wasteful workflows with estimated recoverable minutes, and opens one-line YAML remediation PRs.
